pairs.why: B's anchor has a stronger diagonal tilt and fills the tall card closer to the real card's large tilted hero, though A is nearly as big.
Both coolers fill about the same width and sit centered with open lids, so framing gives no reason to choose.
A's tombstone is oversized and crowds the card, while B's hero is a bit smaller with air around it and a slight turn, closer to the real cards' scale.
A's locker is about as tall as the real one and has similar top and bottom clearance, while B's is smaller and narrower.
The real AC has a clear margin on the left and right, which B keeps. A crowds the left edge and is cropped tighter.
A's pump is a single clean hero centered with open space around it, like the real card. B's barrel and rocks compete with the pump and push it off-center.
B's truss crosses the top edge like the real card and the lamp reads as the main focus. A's floating truss and barn doors add clutter.
A's rover is a bit larger and sits centered low in the card, closer to the real hero scale, while B's is slightly smaller.
